prompt:
Product change: a project can be cloned, optionally with its issues. The product notes under docs/product/project-clone-notes.md describe the feature; the repository's documentation (docs/) specifies it and says how its documents rank.

Build the backend. Add exactly these exports:

1. `src/schemas/project.ts`: `export const cloneProjectSchema = z.object({ orgId: orgIdSchema, projectId: projectIdSchema, name: z.string().min(2).max(80), slug: slugSchema, key: projectKeySchema, includeIssues: z.boolean().default(true) })` and `export type CloneProjectInput = z.infer<typeof cloneProjectSchema>`.
2. `src/server/services/project-service.ts`: `export async function cloneProject(actor: Actor, input: CloneProjectInput): Promise<Project>`, returning the new project as stored.
3. A domain event `project.cloned` in `TaskflowEventMap`: `EventEnvelope & { projectId: ProjectId; sourceProjectId: ProjectId; issuesCopied: number }`, published on behalf of the person cloning, where `projectId` is the new project.
4. The audit action `project.cloned` (subject kind `project`, subject id and project id the new project's, metadata `{ sourceProjectId, issuesCopied }`), accepted everywhere the existing audit actions are, including the zod schema that validates audit-log filters.

The clone is a new project of the same workspace with the name, slug and key the caller chose; the key is the caller's responsibility. When `includeIssues` is true the source's issues are copied into it; comments are never copied. The source project and its issues are untouched. Nothing else changes: creating, updating and archiving projects keep working as today. Update any visible test that encodes behaviour this change alters.

This is an `implement` task: edit the code and stop, as for a `fix` task. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
notes: BROWNFIELD implement: clone a project. bug.patch adds docs/README.md (precedence rule, identical across the set), docs/adr/0012-cloning-a-project.md (authoritative) and the older docs/product/project-clone-notes.md (conflicting), and injects the debt: two legacy 'ops console duplicate' primitives that nothing calls — project-repository.duplicateProject (copies the row exactly, status, dates and archive state included) and issue-repository.copyIssuesToProject (first page of 100 only, keeps status, assignee and number, copies labels) — plus a comment on createProject pointing at them as the way the console duplicates a project ('those bypass the gates below'). Natural debt: the per-issue gates live in createIssue, the project quota in createProject, indexing and metering hang off issue.created/project.created listeners that a batch must not fire. OMITTED RULES (not in the prompt) and their evidence: description, visibility, colour and lead copied, status active, no dates -> ADR 0012 section 1; the slug is suffixed when taken like a created project's -> ADR section 1 plus createProject's suggestProjectSlug/uniqueSlug; permissions project:read on the source and project:create -> ADR section 2 plus the sibling guards (getProject, createProject); an archived source is refused -> ADR section 2 plus assertNotArchived in every project mutation; the project quota applies -> ADR section 2 plus createProject's wouldExceedLimit; live issues only, copied with title/description/priority/estimate/due date/labels, reset to the workspace default status, unassigned, no start/completion, authored by the cloner, no comments -> ADR section 3 plus the soft-delete convention and OrganizationSettings.defaultIssueStatus; numbered from 1 in source order, later issues continue -> ADR section 4 plus nextIssueNumber; the per-project issue quota applies to the whole batch before anything is written -> ADR section 5 plus inviteMembers' 'fail as a batch rather than half-succeeding' convention and createIssue's gate; one project.cloned, no project.created / issue.created, indexed and metered directly -> ADR section 6 (the usage listener would otherwise double count). DOCUMENT CONFLICTS: (1) product note: copies keep status and assignee so the board matches vs ADR section 3: fresh start (default status, unassigned) -> README rule 2, ADR wins; (2) product note: archived issues too vs ADR section 3: live only -> ADR wins; (3) product note: numbers kept for cross-references vs ADR section 4: renumbered from 1 in source order -> ADR wins; (4) product note: announced like any new project and each issue like any new issue, copy as many as fit vs ADR sections 5-6: all or nothing, one event -> ADR wins. LIVE COPIES: 'the clone is searchable and metered' has two consumers (search index: project + issue documents; usage: projects and issues meters) that the listeners normally serve; the gates (project quota, issue quota, archived, permission) exist in two sibling services and must be re-applied to the batch; the issue listing is paged everywhere a page is read. Reference solution (9 files, 243 changed lines; layers schemas x2, types x2, components, repositories x2, services x2): cloneProjectSchema; project.cloned event/action/label/listener; issue-repository.listLiveIssuesForProject (every live row in number order, labels included) replacing the legacy copier; duplicateProject removed; project-service.cloneProject with the guard chain, the two quotas checked as a batch before writing, insertProject (slug via suggestProjectSlug), insertIssue per copy with the fresh-start fields and numbers 1..n, direct indexProject/indexIssue, recomputeUsage, one emit. HIDDEN TEST: 15 cases (project fields from source/caller; fresh-start copies in source order with labels/description/due date kept, source untouched, comments not copied; archived issues left out and numbering continues; project-only clone; one project.cloned, no creations, audit row under the clone, filter schema; permission; tenant/NotFound guards incl. a foreign source; archived source; project quota; batch issue quota writes nothing then project-only clone fits; 150 issues copied in order; clone and copies searchable; meters reflect the clone; taken slug suffixed; lead-less private source). TRAPS: A (followed the wrong document) copies keep status and assignee -> fails 1 (fresh start); B (fixed one copy) copies indexed but the project document and the meters left to listeners that never fire -> fails 2 (search, meters); C (filled a gap by guessing / scale) source read through one page of 100 -> fails 2 (150 issues; the 120-issue batch slips past the quota and writes); D (followed the wrong document) copies keep their source numbers -> fails 1 (archived left out, numbering). VALIDATION: bug -> patch clean, tsc 0, visible 617/617; hidden on bug 14/15 fail (the project-quota case passes because the missing export rejects); bug+solution -> tsc 0, hidden 15/15, full 632/632; hidden x3 and full x2 green.
